messages:
Jordan: Quick async pulse on this quarter's milestone handoffs — please drop shipped/slipped, current owner, and next action.

Maya: Shipped: streaming-cache v1 -> owner @Maya. Docs + rollout done. Follow-up: monitor token cost dashboards. PR #5123.

Ravi: Slipped: smart-routing v2 — perf regressions on long-context paths. Owner @Ravi. Blocker: kernel selector fallback not wired into runtime. ETA: aiming for next sprint.

Sam: Dependency note: smart-routing needs the new batcher API (interface + tests). Owner @Sam. I can land the API stub today but it needs runtime review from @Maya.

Lina: UX: In-console rollout CTA copy needs a tweak before canary. Owner @Lina. Small PR ready: #5130 (just copy + screenshot).

Kai: Release plan: for items shipping this week, tag with `release/2026-06-03` and coordinate canary with infra. @Ravi can you confirm a canary slot?

Ravi: Canary slot confirmed — Tues 10:00–12:00 PT. Reserving GPU pool and will add a short runbook to the ticket.

Maya: CR ping @Sam — can you review #5148 (batcher API) by EOD? This is blocking the smart-routing timeline.

Sam: On it, aiming to land by EOD. If I hit perf surprises I'll flag immediately and add benchmarks.

Jordan: Next step: I'll consolidate these bullets into a 1-paragraph exec summary tomorrow AM. If anything slips beyond next sprint, ping me directly so we can reassign owners.

deploy-bot: Deployed streaming-cache v1 to prod (build a1b2c3) :rocket:

Kai: Noted, I'll add streaming-cache metrics (latency, token-rate, error-rate) to the ship dashboard. @Lina can you confirm metric labels match UX?

Lina: Yep — I'll validate metric names and update the small copy PR if needed.

Jordan: Thanks all. Tiny ask before I compile: please add an `owner:` label to the relevant PRs so I can auto-generate the handoff list for the exec note.
